methods.label: Recover the full ticket price
methods.explanation:
A \(25\%\) discount means that a senior pays \(75\%\) of the full price. Since 6 dollars is \(0.75\) of the full price, divide by \(0.75\) to find that price:
\[
6\div0.75=8\text{ dollars}.
\]
Each child pays half of 8 dollars, or 4 dollars. There are two people in each generation, so the total is
\[
2(6+8+4)=36\text{ dollars}.
\]
Grandfather Wen must pay \(\$36\), choice B.
methods.levelReason: The method uses elementary percentage interpretation, division to recover a whole, and arithmetic with ticket prices.
